Definition: from G4253 and G3724; to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine:--determine before, ordain, predestinate.
BiblicalUsage: Proorizo means to limit in advance, to predetermine, and Paul stakes the doctrine of election on it. Whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, and in the next verse he says whom he did predestinate, them he also called. Ephesians says he predestinated us unto the adoption of children, and Corinthians says the hidden wisdom was ordained before the world unto our glory.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe predestination is the ground of my assurance, not a puzzle to solve: God determined beforehand that his people would be conformed to Christ, and nothing can undo what he determined. My position is that election humbles me and steadies me at once.
